expectation: Beta-tubulin is cytoplasmic and fibrous, present in nearly all cells. It should be dim and broad in epithelium, and brighter in fibre-rich cells such as smooth muscle, nerve and mitotic cells. Expect fibrous texture, not discrete rare cells.
observed: A: the right-hand tissue piece is bright yellow with fibre-like striations, and the same pattern appears in both section copies. The other pieces are dim. There is a diffuse background glow and a rectangular patch outside the tissue. B: banded haze. C: epithelium with dim cytoplasmic yellow around the nuclei. D: bright streaky fibrous blobs.
why: The signal is broad and low-contrast with some haze, but it repeats on the same tissue piece in both sections and follows fibre-like structures, which fits a ubiquitous cytoskeletal marker.
